name: Demetrius
overview: Demetrius was a male silversmith known for his role in stirring up the workmen of Ephesus, as recorded in Acts 19:24. His occupation and actions highlight his influence within the local artisan community during the early Christian movement. No additional tribal or personal notes are recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Demetrius appears once in Scripture without a specific meaning provided. It is simply recorded as a proper name in Acts 19:24.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Demetrius beyond his association as a silversmith involved with the workmen of Ephesus.
scriptureSignificance: Demetrius is significant in the biblical narrative as a representative of those who opposed the spread of the gospel in Ephesus due to economic and cultural concerns. His agitation of the local craftsmen reflects the tension between the Christian message and established pagan practices, illustrating the challenges faced by the early church in a hostile environment.
